item.title: Marvell to Acquire Lumentum for $115B, Challenging Broadcom in Optical Comms
item.description:
Marvell announced a $115 billion all-stock acquisition of optical communications firm Lumentum. If approved, the merger will combine electrical and optical capabilities to challenge Broadcom's dominance in AI optical interconnects, offering cloud providers alternative solutions and greater procurement flexibility. This move is seen as Marvell's strategic preparation for the CPO/NPO era.

原文标题：Marvell 拟 1150 亿美元收购 Lumentum，挑战博通光通信地位

Why it matters：重大并购重塑AI算力基础设施供应链格局，直接影响数据中心光互连技术路线选择。

item.title: Revolut Switches to Self-Hosted GLM for Coding Tasks
item.description:
Fintech giant Revolut has migrated approximately 2,000 engineers from frontier APIs like Claude Code and Codex to a self-hosted GLM model for coding tasks. Leveraging 56 Nvidia B200 GPUs, the setup achieves a blended cost of $0.30 per million tokens—roughly one-tenth of previous API expenses—and reduced engineering lead time by 70%. This shift highlights how open-weight models are becoming the default when cost barriers vanish, posing a significant pricing challenge for proprietary AI labs.

原文标题：Revolut 部署自托管 GLM 替代 Claude 与 Codex

Why it matters：展示了自托管开源模型在大规模企业场景下显著的成本优势与效率提升，具有极强的行业风向标意义。

item.title: Anthropic Restricts Claude Code Game Cloning to Curb IP Infringement
item.description:
Anthropic has added restrictions to the system prompt of Claude Code (Opus 5.5) to explicitly prohibit cloning existing video games. This move addresses a surge in AI-driven unofficial browser ports of titles like Halo and GTA, signaling that intellectual property disputes over AI-generated content are expanding from images and videos into software code. While users can still develop original games, some legitimate projects may face false positives.

原文标题：Anthropic 限制 Claude Code 克隆游戏以遏制侵权

Why it matters：反映了头部 AI 厂商在代码生成领域对版权合规的最新治理动作，对开发者使用 AI 辅助编程的边界有直接指导意义。

item.title: China Pushes for Operationalization of Global AI Cooperation Organization with 38 Founding Members
item.description:
China's National Development and Reform Commission announced efforts to operationalize the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, which has already secured 38 founding member states. The initiative aims to implement the 'Global AI Governance Initiative,' fostering international coordination on AI strategies, governance rules, and technical standards while advocating for open-source inclusivity and culturally tailored intelligent systems.

item.title: SUSE Cuts 10% of Global Workforce Citing AI Impact
item.description:
Open-source software developer SUSE plans to cut 10% of its global workforce, affecting approximately 190 employees. The company cites automation and AI as fundamental drivers changing its operational model, significantly reducing the need for certain roles and making current cost structures a barrier to growth.

item.title: Tencent Plans Consumer AI Search Engine Leveraging Yuanbao Infrastructure
item.description:
Tencent is preparing to launch a minimalist consumer-facing AI search engine that integrates AI Q&A with web search and prioritizes authoritative sources. Built on the existing 'Yuanbao Search' infrastructure currently serving B-end clients, this move aims to monetize search capabilities amid the Agent boom. While official confirmation is pending, insiders indicate it shares the same technical foundation as the Yuanbao App and Tencent Cloud APIs.

item.title: LG Energy Solution Expands North American Battery Capacity to Meet AI Data Center Demand
item.description:
LG Energy Solution plans to expand its North American soft-pack energy storage capacity to over 70 GWh to meet surging demand from AI data centers. With 160 GWh in backlog orders and participation in NVIDIA's DSX Ready program, the company is also advancing LFP cylindrical battery mass production and sodium-ion R&D.

item.title: Panasonic Industry Invests ¥92B in AI Substrates and Capacitors

The move aims to meet the growing long-term demand from AI server components like GPUs, with new facilities scheduled to come online between 2028 and 2029.

item.title: NYT Sues Brave for Scraping Copyrighted Content to Sell to AI Firms
item.description:
The New York Times and other publishers sued browser maker Brave, alleging it used undisclosed crawlers to build a 30-billion-page index and resell copyrighted content to AI firms like Anthropic and Perplexity. The lawsuit also targets Brave's paywall-bypassing features and ad-blocking practices, seeking injunctions and damages.

原文标题：纽约时报起诉 Brave 指控其抓取版权内容转售 AI 公司

item.title: Anthropic S-1 Filing Warns Recursive Self-Improvement Is Near
item.description:
Anthropic's latest S-1/A filing warns that the company is approaching its defined threshold for Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI). The document highlights that using AI to accelerate R&D may cause model capabilities to outpace safety alignment and verification processes, noting past instances of undetected capability jumps. While Anthropic commits to maintaining human oversight and revising its Responsible Scaling Policy, this official risk disclosure marks a shift of RSI from theoretical concept to tangible engineering risk.

原文标题：Anthropic 招股书警示：AI 递归自我改进近在眼前

Why it matters：头部实验室首次在正式法律文件中量化 RSI 风险，对 AI 安全治理具有里程碑意义。

Goldman Sachs CEO David Solomon notes that compute demand still exceeds supply, highlighting value in the application layer. Both executives view market cycles as healthy but warn of fragile capital structures in some projects.

By exposing validated business definitions and data lineage via MCP, CLI, and API, it addresses accuracy issues caused by semantic ambiguity in database queries, supporting automatic ontology generation from metadata with continuous improvement.
